newsitem.title: UK: Timetable for Britain's post-election handover.
newsitem.headline: Timetable for Britain's post-election handover.

text.p: The following is a brief timetable of expected events in London on Friday following the Labour Party's landslide election vctory.
John Major is expected to leave his Downing Street residence at about 1010 GMT for Buckingham Palace to hand in his resignation to Queen Elizabeth.
Labour leader Tony Blair will leave his house in Islington, north London to go to the palace, arriving about 20 minutes after Major leaves.
Blair arrives in Downing street at about 1200 GMT. Top cabinet posts are expected to be announced during the afternoon. --London newsroom +44-171-542-7947
